content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I recently spent a lot of time working on an existing project and saved it under a new name. Today, I'm unable to open it because [product_name] is displaying an "Unknown Error." Does anyone have suggestions for a solution?

It looks like your network project is corrupted. You can only create one [product_name] file from it. I recommend starting a support request and reaching out to [company_name] directly to ask about what went wrong.

Hello [user_name], have you tried making all modifications and opening the project as an administrator? Did you test with other projects to see if the issue repeats? If the error occurs only with this project, it is probably damaged. Technical support may be able to resolve the problem causing the error. Best regards!
Thanks! I had the network setup in an older file and was able to import the .lsc file into a previous project. Can I ask about the method you used?
Do you have an older network project? If so, open that project, select a blank area in the network view, and use the menu to choose "Import."

analysis.insight_summary: Users experienced an issue where a modified and renamed network project created in [product_name] could not be reopened due to an Unknown Error. The community identified that the project file was likely corrupted, and suggested recovering content by importing from an undamaged older file. Project file corruption appears irrecoverable within the software, requiring alternative solutions or assistance from support.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect reliable saving and reopening of project files in [product_name], without unexpected corruption, clear error messages, and effective file recovery options.
